Character.Name: Crosswind
Character.Description: Crosswind is the Field lead of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Wayfarer
Character.Description: Wayfarer is the Quartermaster of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Rations
Character.Description: Rations is the Pathfinder of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Beacon
Character.Description: Beacon is the Riflehand of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Lowbeam
Character.Description: Lowbeam is the Bulwark of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Stow
Character.Description: Stow is the Mechanic of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Gull
Character.Description: Gull is the Medic of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Thread
Character.Description: Thread is the Marksman of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Mica
Character.Description: Mica is the Runner of the Ashline Mutual, working the convoy roads beyond the city. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: dust-tan travel gear with faded teal markings.
Character.Title: Runner

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Crosswind. protective convoy calls, practical route checks, and reassurance for civilians.
Spawned: Crosswind, Field lead, reporting from the convoy roads beyond the city.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Ashline Mutual still has work to finish.
Attacking: Crosswind taking the field lead lane. a spare seat is a promise.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the convoy roads beyond the city.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Crosswind confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Crosswind is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Crosswind - Ashline Mutual combat chatter
